blocks.text: Ezekiel 11 contains 25 verses. It opens with: Moreover the Spirit lifted me up, and brought me unto the east gate of Jehovah's house, which looketh eastward: and behold, at the door of the gate five and twenty men; and I saw in the midst of them Jaazaniah the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, princes of the people. It concludes with: Then I spake unto them of the captivity all the things that Jehovah had showed me.
